newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Motta delivers telecoms bill to Congress.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Motta delivers telecoms bill to Congress.

text.p: Brazilian Communications Minister Sergio Motta has delivered a bill containing Brazil's new General Telecomminications Law to Congress' lower house.
"I'm going to hand in the law," Motta told reporters shortly before entering the office of Chamber of Deputies President Rep. Luis Eduardo Magalhaes.
He declined to make further comments.
Details of the bill were not immediately available.
The ministry plans to publish the full 200-page document in Portuguese on its Internet website, which is found at www.mc.gov.br.
The ministry said Motta has scheduled a news conference for 1030 local/1230 GMT on Friday to explain and answer questions on the proposed law.
The law is expected to create a powerful regulatory watchdog for the sector, set general telecoms policy and outline government plans to break up and sell off the federal Telebras SA.
